People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of clinical trial safety and regulatory requirements.
cond_0625.responsibilities:
Evaluate and manage the safety of participants throughout the lifecycle of the clinical trials
Monitor participants and account for any adverse events and initiate proper actions if needed
Participate in protocol development, and study reporting
Supervise the studies and ensure protocol adherence
Complete case report forms and present safety issues within meetings
Maintain knowledge of medical best practices
Review laboratory results, eligibility criteria, and safety parameters in accordance with study protocols
cond_0625.requirements:
Medical degree (MD/DO or equivalent)
Active Medical License in [Location masked] or willingness to obtain [Location masked] licensure
Experience in clinical research, preferably in pharmaceutical or CRO settings
Strong understanding of ICH-GCP guidelines and regulatory requirements
cond_0625.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
